name: Belize Fund Grants Award Program

funder.name: Belize Fund for a Sustainable Future

summary: Annual call from Belize's blue-bonds trust fund for community, medium and large grants to non-government groups working on coastal and marine conservation, fisheries, climate resilience and blue-economy projects, via a concept paper then full proposal.

amount.note: Community grants up to BZ$100,000; medium BZ$50,000-150,000; large BZ$150,000-500,000

status.quote: The Belize Fund invites eligible organizations and community groups to submit a Concept Paper under its 5th Call for Proposals for the 2026-2027 funding cycle.

pool.quote: Each year, 40% of Belize Fund financing-approximately BZ$3.2 million-is allocated through GAP.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include NGOs, community-based and civil society organizations, academic institutions, local associations, and private entities.

geography.quote: Projects should focus on Belize's coastal and marine environments

access.quote: The Belize Fund invites eligible organizations and community groups to submit a Concept Paper under its 5th Call for Proposals for the 2026-2027 funding cycle.

window.quote: Every August, the Belize Fund opens its annual Call for Proposals, inviting eligible non-government entities to submit concept papers for funding.

amount.quote: Medium Grant Awards between BZ$50,000 and $150,000 Not exceeding 2 year (10% co-financing required) Large Grant Awards between BZ$150,000 and $500,000 Not exceeding 2 -3 year (25% co-financing required) Community Grant Awards up to BZ$100,000 Not exceeding 1-2 years (10% co-financing required above BZ$50,000)

co_finance_required.quote: Medium Grant Awards between BZ$50,000 and $150,000 Not exceeding 2 year (10% co-financing required) Large Grant Awards between BZ$150,000 and $500,000 Not exceeding 2 -3 year (25% co-financing required) Community Grant Awards up to BZ$100,000 Not exceeding 1-2 years (10% co-financing required above BZ$50,000)
